name: calls/decode
doc: the decode call's contract, the facts that do not depend on the depth: every (d_v, decay) FSLA accepts and the step's write_dense. A list is alternatives, each its own context; a range is one context. d_v is a range because the seam pads any value width up to the arm that serves it (decode's launch function maps d_v into the arm's, common/plan/decode_launch.h). The depth and the level widths are a depth part's (calls/depth1 .. calls/depth4), composed beside this one.

d_v.declared_by: docs/internals/decode/arms_gen.md#the-contract: the value widths a decode arm serves, 2 up to its widest arm; fsla/_state.py's StateFormat admits an even width from 2

decay.declared_by: docs/internals/decode/arms_gen.md#the-contract: the recurrence either decays (1) or not (0)

write_dense.declared_by: fsla/ops/produce.py decode_descriptor: the producer's rule from the declaration chooses it, 1 when the innermost level's write activation has no exact zeros (docs/internals/decode/decode.md#whole-atoms); either value is a lawful call
